qualifications: Scholarships are limited and based on academic merit

description_short: The Hague Academy of International Law's 2027 Summer Courses at the Peace Palace run in two sessions: Public International Law (5-23 July 2027) and Private International Law (26 July-13 August 2027). Applications, including scholarship requests, are accepted from 1 November 2026 to 31 January 2027.
